9.7.13.2. Control Flow Instructions: @
@
Predicated execution.
@{!}p    instruction;
Execute an instruction or instruction block for threads that have the guard predicate True. Threads with a False guard predicate do nothing.

reason_for_inclusion: KEY evidence for the Gate B rejection directive: the general predication/control-flow section 9.7.13.2 explicitly states 'Threads with a False guard predicate do nothing.' This is the official clause that grounds the guard-false no-state-update consequence for predicated instructions; by the general predicability rule (PTX-9.3-MOV-016, PTX-9.3-MOV-021) it applies to all PTX instructions, including mov.b32.
